description: frugal: load the session rules at the 10th user message, then every 15th, and the handoff rule every 150k tokens of context; with secondary accounts set up, steer bounded work to them; in Claude Desktop, a side agent on a secondary account reads longer turns and wakes Claude with a heads-up

hooks.command: sh -c '[ -f "$HOME/.frugal/accounts.json" ] || exit 0; exec python "$1" hook-prompt' sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/accounts/server.py"
sh -c '[ -f "$HOME/.frugal/accounts.json" ] || exit 0; exec python "$1" hook-pretool' sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/accounts/server.py"
sh -c '[ -f "$HOME/.frugal/accounts.json" ] || exit 0; exec python "$1" hook-stop' sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/accounts/server.py"
